meta.title: Duncan & Wright fig. 14.20b, Su = 200 + 15·depth, non-circular search
meta.notes: Granular fill over clay with undrained strength increasing linearly with depth; critical-circle search.

source.reference: Duncan & Wright, Soil Strength and Slope Stability, fig. 14.20b.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V034a (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Duncan, Wright & Brandon (2014, Table 14.1) give 1.276 at θs = 1° and 3° and up to 1.323 at larger θs; until 2026-10-25 the check carried 1.300, the midpoint of that range, which is not in the table. Profile I goes with the shallow circle I. commercial program A Spencer 1.285 (circle).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
Checks de búsqueda no circular del problema V034a de cSlope. El caso lleva el sufijo `-nc` porque `V034a` ya está en `verification/cases` con otros checks y otro modelo (búsqueda circular).
